verdict.rationale: The evidence documents fiat-to-crypto on-ramp and crypto-to-fiat off-ramp flows, where the end user buys or sells crypto, plus webhooks and quote and session APIs. Nothing shows a merchant checkout or payment API for receiving a stablecoin payment from a customer: no create-payment call, no deposit address or payment flow presented to a payer, and no settlement confirmation to the merchant. Crypto payment acceptance is a fair axis for a crypto payments company, so this is none rather than na.
